title: Authentication fails with OAuth providers intermittently
body:
## Description
When trying to authenticate with Google OAuth, the callback occasionally fails with a 500 error. This seems to happen more frequently when multiple tabs are open.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open the app in 2+ browser tabs
2. Click 'Sign in with Google' in one tab
3. Complete Google authentication
4. Sometimes observe error on callback

## Expected behavior
User should be logged in successfully every time.

## Environment
- Browser: Chrome 120
- OS: macOS 14.2
author: cdavis

comments.author: imartinez
comments.body: I'm looking into this now. Initial investigation suggests it's related to the session token handling when multiple instances try to authenticate simultaneously.

comments.author: achen
comments.body: I've seen similar issues before. Check if the state parameter is being properly validated across tabs.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts for common actions
body:
## Feature Request
Power users would benefit from keyboard shortcuts for common actions.

## Proposed shortcuts
- `Cmd/Ctrl + K` - Command palette
- `Cmd/Ctrl + /` - Toggle sidebar
- `Cmd/Ctrl + S` - Save
- `Cmd/Ctrl + Enter` - Submit form

## Additional context
Many modern apps support these patterns (VS Code, Notion, etc.)
author: palves

title: Performance degradation with large datasets
body:
## Problem
When loading more than 10,000 records in the data table, the UI becomes sluggish and unresponsive.

## Analysis
Profiling shows excessive re-renders in the table component. Virtual scrolling might help.

## Proposed Solution
Implement react-window or similar virtualization library.
author: achen

title: Add unit tests for notification service
body:
We need comprehensive unit tests for the new notification service before the v2.1 release.

Test coverage needed:
- WebSocket connection/reconnection
- Message queue handling
- Offline support
- Rate limiting
author: lscott

title: Mobile responsiveness issues on settings page
body: The settings page doesn't display correctly on mobile devices. Buttons overlap and text is cut off on screens smaller than 375px.
author: syoung

title: Implement rate limiting for API endpoints
body:
We need to add rate limiting to prevent API abuse.

Proposed limits:
- 100 requests/minute for authenticated users
- 20 requests/minute for unauthenticated users
- 1000 requests/hour for API keys

title: Memory leak in dashboard component
body:
## Bug Report
The dashboard component has a memory leak that becomes noticeable after extended use.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open dashboard
2. Switch between tabs repeatedly
3. Monitor memory usage

## Expected
Memory should stabilize

## Actual
Memory grows continuously
author: imartinez

comments.author: imartinez
comments.body: Found the issue - event listeners not being cleaned up on unmount.
